claims.claim: **Offer STI screening and prevention counselling opportunistically to every sexually active adolescent who presents for healthcare.** Many STIs are asymptomatic but cause serious complications.
claims.locator: The Royal Children's Hospital Melbourne, Clinical Practice Guidelines: 'Sexually transmitted infections (STIs)' (Last updated November 2022), at https://www.rch.org.au/clinicalguide/guideline_index/Sexually_transmitted_infections_STIs/, retrieved 2026-09-23

claims.claim: ⚠️ **Confidentiality holds unless the adolescent cannot be considered a mature minor and/or there is significant risk** — sexual or physical abuse, harm to self or others. If abuse is suspected, **urgent referral** to local services.
claims.locator: The Royal Children's Hospital Melbourne, Clinical Practice Guidelines: 'Sexually transmitted infections (STIs)' (Last updated November 2022), at https://www.rch.org.au/clinicalguide/guideline_index/Sexually_transmitted_infections_STIs/, retrieved 2026-09-23

claims.claim: **Also assess pregnancy risk (test where appropriate), the need for emergency contraception, and ongoing contraception.**
claims.locator: The Royal Children's Hospital Melbourne, Clinical Practice Guidelines: 'Sexually transmitted infections (STIs)' (Last updated November 2022), at https://www.rch.org.au/clinicalguide/guideline_index/Sexually_transmitted_infections_STIs/, retrieved 2026-09-23

claims.claim: **Test by NAAT on:** first-pass urine, or a vaginal swab (self-collected) or endocervical swab (clinician-collected); anorectal and pharyngeal swabs for MSM. **No symptoms in 75% of women and 50% of men.**
claims.locator: The Royal Children's Hospital Melbourne, Clinical Practice Guidelines: 'Sexually transmitted infections (STIs)' (Last updated November 2022), at https://www.rch.org.au/clinicalguide/guideline_index/Sexually_transmitted_infections_STIs/, retrieved 2026-09-23

claims.claim: **Uncomplicated genital or asymptomatic rectal:** doxycycline PO 2 mg/kg (max 100 mg) bd for 7 days (generally not for children 8 years or under) **or** azithromycin PO 20 mg/kg (max 1 g) as one dose.
claims.locator: The Royal Children's Hospital Melbourne, Clinical Practice Guidelines: 'Sexually transmitted infections (STIs)' (Last updated November 2022), at https://www.rch.org.au/clinicalguide/guideline_index/Sexually_transmitted_infections_STIs/, retrieved 2026-09-23

claims.claim: **Symptomatic anorectal:** a 21-day doxycycline course **or** azithromycin 1 g stat, given again 12–24 hours later.
claims.locator: The Royal Children's Hospital Melbourne, Clinical Practice Guidelines: 'Sexually transmitted infections (STIs)' (Last updated November 2022), at https://www.rch.org.au/clinicalguide/guideline_index/Sexually_transmitted_infections_STIs/, retrieved 2026-09-23

claims.claim: **If suspicion is high, treat without waiting for results.** Abstain from sex for 7 days after treatment, and from sex with any partner of the past 6 months until that partner is tested and treated.
claims.locator: The Royal Children's Hospital Melbourne, Clinical Practice Guidelines: 'Sexually transmitted infections (STIs)' (Last updated November 2022), at https://www.rch.org.au/clinicalguide/guideline_index/Sexually_transmitted_infections_STIs/, retrieved 2026-09-23

claims.claim: **Follow up after 1 week.** Test of cure is not routinely recommended; **retest for re-infection at 3 months.**
claims.locator: The Royal Children's Hospital Melbourne, Clinical Practice Guidelines: 'Sexually transmitted infections (STIs)' (Last updated November 2022), at https://www.rch.org.au/clinicalguide/guideline_index/Sexually_transmitted_infections_STIs/, retrieved 2026-09-23

claims.claim: ⚠️ **Always collect gonococcal culture before treatment, but do not delay treatment for the result.** Symptomatic: NAAT and MCS. **Co-infection with chlamydia is common.**
claims.locator: The Royal Children's Hospital Melbourne, Clinical Practice Guidelines: 'Sexually transmitted infections (STIs)' (Last updated November 2022), at https://www.rch.org.au/clinicalguide/guideline_index/Sexually_transmitted_infections_STIs/, retrieved 2026-09-23

claims.claim: **Uncomplicated genital and anorectal:** ceftriaxone IM 50 mg/kg (max 500 mg) as one dose **and** azithromycin PO 20 mg/kg (max 1 g) as one dose — **pharyngeal infection: azithromycin 2 g.**
claims.locator: The Royal Children's Hospital Melbourne, Clinical Practice Guidelines: 'Sexually transmitted infections (STIs)' (Last updated November 2022), at https://www.rch.org.au/clinicalguide/guideline_index/Sexually_transmitted_infections_STIs/, retrieved 2026-09-23

claims.claim: **No sex for 7 days after treatment**, and none with any partner of the past 2 months until that partner is tested and treated. **Test of cure by NAAT at each infected site 2 weeks after treatment**; retest at 3 months.
claims.locator: The Royal Children's Hospital Melbourne, Clinical Practice Guidelines: 'Sexually transmitted infections (STIs)' (Last updated November 2022), at https://www.rch.org.au/clinicalguide/guideline_index/Sexually_transmitted_infections_STIs/, retrieved 2026-09-23

claims.claim: ⚠️ **Refer to gynaecology and begin treatment without waiting for results.**
claims.locator: The Royal Children's Hospital Melbourne, Clinical Practice Guidelines: 'Sexually transmitted infections (STIs)' (Last updated November 2022), at https://www.rch.org.au/clinicalguide/guideline_index/Sexually_transmitted_infections_STIs/, retrieved 2026-09-23

claims.claim: **Outpatient:** ceftriaxone IM 50 mg/kg (max 500 mg) as one dose **plus** doxycycline PO 2 mg/kg (max 100 mg) bd for 14 days **plus** metronidazole PO 10 mg/kg (max 400 mg) bd for 14 days.
claims.locator: The Royal Children's Hospital Melbourne, Clinical Practice Guidelines: 'Sexually transmitted infections (STIs)' (Last updated November 2022), at https://www.rch.org.au/clinicalguide/guideline_index/Sexually_transmitted_infections_STIs/, retrieved 2026-09-23

claims.claim: ⚠️ **Admit for:** surgical emergency not excluded (e.g. appendicitis) · pregnancy · failure or intolerance of oral treatment · severe illness, vomiting or high fever · tubo-ovarian abscess · immunodeficiency.
claims.locator: The Royal Children's Hospital Melbourne, Clinical Practice Guidelines: 'Sexually transmitted infections (STIs)' (Last updated November 2022), at https://www.rch.org.au/clinicalguide/guideline_index/Sexually_transmitted_infections_STIs/, retrieved 2026-09-23

claims.claim: **IV regimen (for admitted patients):** IV ceftriaxone 100 mg/kg (max 2 g) daily **or** IV cefotaxime 50 mg/kg (max 2 g) 8-hourly, **plus** IV azithromycin 10 mg/kg (max 500 mg) daily, **plus** IV metronidazole 12.5 mg/kg (max 500 mg) 12-hourly.
claims.locator: The Royal Children's Hospital Melbourne, Clinical Practice Guidelines: 'Sexually transmitted infections (STIs)' (Last updated November 2022), at https://www.rch.org.au/clinicalguide/guideline_index/Sexually_transmitted_infections_STIs/, retrieved 2026-09-23

claims.claim: **Do not delay treatment for results, particularly if severe.** Swab the ulcer base or de-roofed vesicle for HSV NAAT; **serological screening of asymptomatic people is not recommended.**
claims.locator: The Royal Children's Hospital Melbourne, Clinical Practice Guidelines: 'Sexually transmitted infections (STIs)' (Last updated November 2022), at https://www.rch.org.au/clinicalguide/guideline_index/Sexually_transmitted_infections_STIs/, retrieved 2026-09-23

claims.claim: **First episode, 5–10 days of:** valaciclovir PO 20 mg/kg (max 500 mg) bd **or** aciclovir PO 10 mg/kg (max 400 mg) tds.
claims.locator: The Royal Children's Hospital Melbourne, Clinical Practice Guidelines: 'Sexually transmitted infections (STIs)' (Last updated November 2022), at https://www.rch.org.au/clinicalguide/guideline_index/Sexually_transmitted_infections_STIs/, retrieved 2026-09-23

claims.claim: **Episodic recurrence:** valaciclovir PO 20 mg/kg (max 500 mg) bd for 3 days **or**, over 12 years, famciclovir PO 1 g bd for 1 day. **Suppression:** valaciclovir PO 20 mg/kg (max 500 mg) daily for 6 months **or**, over 12 years, famciclovir PO 250 mg bd for 6 months.
claims.locator: The Royal Children's Hospital Melbourne, Clinical Practice Guidelines: 'Sexually transmitted infections (STIs)' (Last updated November 2022), at https://www.rch.org.au/clinicalguide/guideline_index/Sexually_transmitted_infections_STIs/, retrieved 2026-09-23

claims.claim: **Contact tracing is not recommended.** GP follow-up in 1 week.
claims.locator: The Royal Children's Hospital Melbourne, Clinical Practice Guidelines: 'Sexually transmitted infections (STIs)' (Last updated November 2022), at https://www.rch.org.au/clinicalguide/guideline_index/Sexually_transmitted_infections_STIs/, retrieved 2026-09-23

claims.claim: **Bacterial vaginosis:** metronidazole PO 10 mg/kg (max 400 mg) bd for 7 days **or** intravaginal metronidazole 0.75% gel nocte, 5 nights (not on PBS) **or** 2% clindamycin vaginal cream nocte, 7 days (also not on PBS).
claims.locator: The Royal Children's Hospital Melbourne, Clinical Practice Guidelines: 'Sexually transmitted infections (STIs)' (Last updated November 2022), at https://www.rch.org.au/clinicalguide/guideline_index/Sexually_transmitted_infections_STIs/, retrieved 2026-09-23

claims.claim: **Trichomoniasis:** metronidazole 2 g PO single dose (over 12 years) **or** metronidazole PO 10 mg/kg (max 400 mg) bd for 7 days. **Do not use topical treatment**; no sex for 7 days; **treat the current partner.**
claims.locator: The Royal Children's Hospital Melbourne, Clinical Practice Guidelines: 'Sexually transmitted infections (STIs)' (Last updated November 2022), at https://www.rch.org.au/clinicalguide/guideline_index/Sexually_transmitted_infections_STIs/, retrieved 2026-09-23

claims.claim: **Syphilis — primary, secondary or early latent:** IM benzathine penicillin G, one dose of 50 000 units/kg (max 2.4 million units), split into 2 injections (each max 1.2 million units).
claims.locator: The Royal Children's Hospital Melbourne, Clinical Practice Guidelines: 'Sexually transmitted infections (STIs)' (Last updated November 2022), at https://www.rch.org.au/clinicalguide/guideline_index/Sexually_transmitted_infections_STIs/, retrieved 2026-09-23

claims.claim: **Late latent (over 2 years) or unknown duration:** the same dose given once a week, 3 doses in all. **Infectious diseases referral; repeat RPR at 3, 6 and possibly 12 months.**
claims.locator: The Royal Children's Hospital Melbourne, Clinical Practice Guidelines: 'Sexually transmitted infections (STIs)' (Last updated November 2022), at https://www.rch.org.au/clinicalguide/guideline_index/Sexually_transmitted_infections_STIs/, retrieved 2026-09-23

claims.claim: **Genital warts:** treatment is cosmetic, not curative; avoid shaving or waxing the area; **refer to gynaecology** for imiquimod, cryotherapy or excision. **Prevent with HPV vaccination.**
claims.locator: The Royal Children's Hospital Melbourne, Clinical Practice Guidelines: 'Sexually transmitted infections (STIs)' (Last updated November 2022), at https://www.rch.org.au/clinicalguide/guideline_index/Sexually_transmitted_infections_STIs/, retrieved 2026-09-23

claims.claim: ⚠️ **Consult gynaecology when inpatient PID management is needed.** If sexual assault is suspected, follow local guidelines — **early specialist consultation is vital.**
claims.locator: The Royal Children's Hospital Melbourne, Clinical Practice Guidelines: 'Sexually transmitted infections (STIs)' (Last updated November 2022), at https://www.rch.org.au/clinicalguide/guideline_index/Sexually_transmitted_infections_STIs/, retrieved 2026-09-23

claims.claim: **Discharge with a clear plan for following up results and any further treatment.**
claims.locator: The Royal Children's Hospital Melbourne, Clinical Practice Guidelines: 'Sexually transmitted infections (STIs)' (Last updated November 2022), at https://www.rch.org.au/clinicalguide/guideline_index/Sexually_transmitted_infections_STIs/, retrieved 2026-09-23
